fields.bio.en: Frontend Engineer specializing in Vue.js, Nuxt, and Tailwind CSS, with a background in industrial design and a strong eye for visual detail and user experience. Independently built the frontend of a course sales platform, led the upgrade from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and the migration from Webpack to Vite, and refactored code to make pages load about 3–5x faster. Recently, I've been building a personal homelab with Raspberry Pi and exploring workflow automation with n8n.

work.work.name: United Daily News Co., Ltd.
work.work.description:
Owned frontend development for online course platforms: built 'U Haoxue (U 好學)' solo and led the frontend architecture of 'Yike Jingxuan (一刻鯨選)'.

• Sole frontend developer of 'U Haoxue (U 好學)', delivering course preview and checkout features with Nuxt.js; launched January 2026
• Led frontend architecture of 'Yike Jingxuan (一刻鯨選)', building e-commerce-like course sales functionality
• Encapsulated a video player plugin to enhance product extensibility
• Refactored and optimized code, cutting load times by roughly 3–5x
• Led the migration from Webpack to Vite and the upgrade from Vue 2 to Vue 3
• Integrated Tailwind CSS to enhance development efficiency and code maintainability
